Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Structuring observability addons for Brightline pilot

Hi David —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Two quick asks from our side as we prepare procurement: 1) a compact summary of how retention, tracing credits, and advanced dashboards would be packaged for a 90-day pilot vs a 12‑month commit, and 2) a clear discount path if we convert to a production commitment at the end of the pilot.

Our technical team cares most about trace ingest costs and long‑tail retention (archival beyond 90 days); the product team wants to understand whether dashboards are seat-based or a seatless visualization SKU.

I attached the draft SOW for context (Brightline_SOW_v1.pdf). Can you loop in pricing and a short commercial note we can hand to procurement?

Thanks —
Jordan Price
Director, Platform Engineering
Brightline Health

Attachments: Brightline_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, 1 page)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@brightline.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structuring observability addons for Brightline pilot

Jordan —

Appreciate the SOW — good context. High level commercial options below; attaching a simple pricing matrix for line items (pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx). Irene and I included technical notes inline.

Pilot (90 days; low touch):
- Retention: 30 days included; archival beyond 30 days billed at metered TB rates.
- Tracing: 100k trace events/day included; overage billed per 10k events.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards offered as a seatless visualization SKU with a fixed monthly fee in the pilot.
- Pilot credit: we can provide $12k in consumption credits toward traces/retention during the 90‑day pilot.

Production (12 months; standard commit):
- Retention: 90 days included; archival tier discounted by 30% vs pilot metered rate.
- Tracing: baseline included scaled to committed throughput; overage rates reduced by 25%.
- Dashboards: option to convert to seat-based pricing (discounted if >10 seats) or keep seatless at scale pricing.
- Discount path: commit to 12 months at a minimum $150k ARR and we can offer a 20% unit discount + 3 months of advanced-dashboards at no charge in year one.

Enterprise (Dedicated/private):
- Custom retention SLAs, dedicated KV caching, and predictable throughput. Pricing via SOW.

Irene — any technical caveats on tracing ingest or retention that would change the commercial assumptions above?

Next steps: Ben can draft a concise commercial note and, if acceptable, we’ll produce an updated pricing spreadsheet and DocuSign-ready SOW.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx (pricing grid)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@brightline.health>, Brightline Procurement <procurement@brightline.health>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Structuring observability addons for Brightline pilot

Jordan / Procurement team —

Thanks — quick commercial clarification and a concession we can make to accelerate the pilot:

1) Pilot packaging (concrete):
   - Retention: 30d included; archival beyond 30d at $0.018/GB/month.
   - Tracing: 100k spans/day included; additional spans at $0.50 per 10k.
   - Dashboards: Seatless advanced dashboards at $3k/month during pilot.

2) Concession to close:
   - If Brightline signs a 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot end (minimum $150k ARR), we will:
     * Apply a one-time conversion credit equal to 50% of pilot consumption credits (effectively 6k back onto the first invoice), and
     * Reduce archival pricing by an additional 10% for the first 12 months.

3) Operational/one-time items:
   - One-time onboarding & SSO setup fee of $12k — we will waive this fee if you commit to the 12mo deal.

Irene: we will need a short technical appendix in the SOW about trace sampling thresholds and KV cache sizing; can you produce that and I’ll drop it into the SOW before DocuSign?

Jordan — I can produce an updated pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx with the exact line-item numbers and a DocuSign link once you confirm the commercial path you prefer (pilot → production conversion vs straight 12mo).

Best —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced earlier: pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx

Ben / David —

Thanks for the clear options. A couple of procurement asks before we circulate to legal:

- Please confirm the seatless dashboard SKU is a license fee (monthly fixed) and list the exact MRR if Brightline stays on pilot pricing vs converts. We need the line on the PO to match the invoice.
- Confirm the archival price you quoted ($0.018/GB/month) is capped for the first 12 months if we sign the 12mo conversion within the 30‑day window.
- Please provide an updated pricing spreadsheet with the conversion credit reflected as a invoice credit line item and an updated SOW that includes Irene’s technical appendix.
- We are requesting a final commercial concession of 20% off total first‑year ARR as an explicit line item. Please confirm whether Brightline can have that as part of the deal economics.

For reference we have the SOW attached that we’d like you to return with the quoted numbers embedded and signable: Brightline_SOW_v1.pdf (attached earlier).

Thanks —
Procurement Team
